newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Bloch rises on new shareholder news.
newsitem.headline: Bloch rises on new shareholder news.

text.p: Shares in South African supermarket outfit Bloch Ltd rose on Wednesday after news that a consortium will buy some 12.49 million shares or 67 percent of its share capital resulting in a change of control at the group.
"It is a positive move when someone takes control of a firm," said one dealer.
The firm's shares moved up 20 cents to a new year high of 180 cents in volume of 24,000 shares.

Bloch said that of the shares bought, 2.89 million will immediately be renounced to various independent investors, resulting in the consortium ending up with 9.6 million Bloch shares, representing a 51.3 percent stake.
An offer is also to be made to minority shareholders.
Bloch said that the consortium would purchase its stake from Bloch Holdings Channel Islands Ltd, as well as two private persons and their associates at 105 cents per Blochs share, to be paid in cash.
The deal takes effect on Wednesday.
